processing.projection: Local equirectangular, x=(unwrapped longitude-central meridian)*cos(standard parallel), y=-latitude; uniform scale and centered padding
processing.roundingDecimals: 1 normally; adaptive 4/6/8/10 to prevent tiny-ring collapse
processing.contextAlignment: Shared parent projection, scaling and translation
processing.rings: All nondegenerate exterior/interior rings retained and normalized for nonzero fill; 293 numerically zero-area source interior slivers are listed in the coverage report; no islands relocated or independently enlarged
processing.remoteTerritories: Only France uses a geographic extent: European mainland and Corsica, not overseas regions. Every omitted polygon is listed per feature below. All source polygons of other selected countries are retained, including adjacent islands and remote parts; no mainland-centroid distance filter is used.
processing.difficulty: Manually assigned gameplay heuristic; not an objective geographic classification
processing.distractors: City choices use stable IDs from the same province; country distractors follow the versioned easy/medium/hard curation table (draft pending playtest).
